title: tc-day-rhythm
description:
A typical day as a strip of blocks by kind of place or activity, one row per kind of day, with hour ticks, a legend,
a now marker and a readout of the block under the pointer or focus.

description.description: One line under the heading, e.g. "Typical day, last 30 days"

kinds.description: The kinds of place or activity, in legend order

now.description: A marker at this time, in minutes from midnight; none when unset

label.description: The kind's name, in the legend and on wide blocks: "Work"

color.description: Which chart colour, 1–6; by default the kinds take them in order

label.description: The row's name beside its strip, e.g. "Weekdays"; with one row it can be left out

end.description: Minutes from midnight, 0–1440; less than `start` when the block runs past midnight

place.description: Where or what, in the readout: "Harbour office"
